You are auditing labels of a pointing dataset. Each row below shows one video frame of an indoor room and one claim about it.
- A "point" row has a red ring drawn on the image. Its claim: the centre of the ring lies on a visible part of an object of the named kind.
- An "absent" row has no ring. Its claim: no object of the named kind is visible anywhere in the image.
Judge every claim from its image alone, and answer for each row:
"present": is at least one object of the named kind visible in the image, fully or partly? true or false.
"on_object": point rows only: is the centre of the ring on a visible part of an object of the named kind? true or false; null for absent rows.
"name_fits": point rows only: would most people call the object under the centre of the ring by the given name or a close synonym? true or false; null for absent rows.
"point": when present is true and the claim is wrong (an absent row, or on_object false), one point on a visible part of the named object as [x, y] in 0-1000 image coordinates (x = 0 left edge, 1000 right edge; y = 0 top edge, 1000 bottom edge); otherwise null.
Reply with one JSON object and nothing else: {"<row id>": {"present": ..., "on_object": ..., "name_fits": ..., "point": ...}, ...} with all 10 row ids.
